messages:
maria_support: Heads-up — customer reports function-calling / structured tool output validation failure after last deploy. Error: 'invalid enum value for params.action'. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. They included a curl but we couldn't reproduce locally. Need repro steps + debug bundle. CC @alex_eng @jordan_sre

alex_eng: can you paste the curl + response body? also which model/runtime were they using (helps triage)?

maria_support: pasted the exact curl they ran (token redacted) and the response they got:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d" \
  -d '{
    "model":"redwood-tool-1",
    "input":"save invoice",
    "tool_call": {
      "name":"save_invoice",
      "params": {"invoice_id":"inv-123", "action":"archive"}
    }
  }'
```

And response:

```json
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error":"structured_toolcall_validation_failed",
  "message":"invalid enum for params.action: 'archive'",
  "allowed":["archived","deleted"],
  "request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d",
  "trace":"trace-9876"
}
```

jordan_sre: interesting — allowed values are 'archived' and 'deleted', implies tool metadata was updated (suffix change). Could be mismatch between cached tool schema on runtime and latest catalog. Was this customer on hosted or dedicated?

maria_support: hosted (us-west-2). They said it started right after the 2026-02-01 deploy window.

ryan_ml: quick check: try the same request with params.action = 'archived' to see if it works. If it does, likely a client/schema mismatch rather than model bug.

alex_eng: also ask customer to return response headers (x-runtime-version, x-model-hash) and we'll pull server logs for req_0a1b2c3d. I can kick off a debug bundle collection.

eng-bot: created debug bundle s3://redwood-debug/support/2005012345/req_0a1b2c3d.tar.gz (expires in 7d) — includes traces, model-metadata snapshots, and route logs.

maria_support: sent link to customer and asked them to run this test command (note: token redacted):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d-try2" \
  -H "X-Debug: 1" \
  -d '{
    "model":"redwood-tool-1",
    "input":"save invoice",
    "tool_call": {
      "name":"save_invoice",
      "params": {"invoice_id":"inv-123", "action":"archived", "cache_bust":true}
    }
  }'
```

maria_support: Customer ran the modified request and got 200 OK; toolcall returned success. So changing to the new enum fixed it. They insist they didn't change client code — could be stale client schema or server-side cached metadata. Jordan, can you check KV cache TTLs for tool metadata and any stalled propagation around that deploy?

jordan_sre: on it — pulling deploy timeline and KV cache metrics for us-west-2. If metadata propagation lagged, we'll see spikes in fetch latency and stale_hits. Will report back with logs for req_0a1b2c3d and surrounding window.

alex_eng: follow-up item: we should include a clearer error payload when enum mismatch happens — e.g., return current schema hash + previous schema hash to help clients auto-update. Filing a small RFC/bug.

maria_support: sounds good. I'll keep customer updated and ask them to update SDK or clear any local tool metadata caches as a workaround. Labeling: escalation, repro-needed, toolcall. :thumbsup:

support-bot: ticket #SUP-2026-891 created and linked to debug bundle.

jordan_sre: FYI logs show a brief KV cache propagation lag from 2026-02-01T02:14Z–02:18Z; several requests during that window hit older schema. I'll attach log snippets to the ticket.

maria_support: thanks all — I'll close the loop with the customer and confirm resolution once they update SDK. If they still see failures after clearing caches, we'll reopen and attach the debug bundle + logs.
